gripOrHq.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

gripOrHq.title: Self-Modifying Code
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

rig.title: Snowball
rig.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

ice.title: Fetch 4.0.1
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Data Raven
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag and a Data Raven counter. Each Data Raven counter gives Runner a tag at the start of each Runner turn. Runner may remove a Data Raven counter by taking an action to pay [1].

setAside.title: Self-Modifying Code
setAside.rulesText: [T]: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.
